behavior: Supported level, mission and episode item adds/stack updates wait for the complete original Player Character save. Frozen inventory capture includes only notices accepted before that capture; direct Inventory.Save cannot confirm a Path reward marker.

Full-save capture freezes the current Item membership and quantity. Removed-item adds/stacks are suppressed. Related ordinary add/stack/delete notices on a pending/ready Path Item GUID stay ordered and preserve their original reasons; unrelated ordinary items keep the existing route.

Commit failure retains notices. Successful callbacks confirm captured notice identities only, so later Auth earning/consumption waits for its own save. Partial enqueue failure retries from the first undelivered packet without replaying the grant.
Every attempt constructs a fresh packet/deep item payload. Original Player/PathManager/inventory/Character/realm/account/id/epoch/session/queue ownership and disconnect state fence publication.
